assets.prompt: Macro studio product photography on a matte black anodized aluminum optical bench (#080A0E). Three distinct thin precision light beams—warm amber (#FABD2F), cool steel cyan-blue (#8FBCB0), and crisp coral-orange (#FE8A2B)—enter from the left through three smoked dark-glass optical prisms, converging cleanly inside a central precision crystal cube into a single luminous mint-emerald verification beam (#8FF5AA) exiting to the right. Subtle physical refraction, realistic machined metal mounts, Leica/Teenage Engineering industrial craft, shallow depth of field, zero text, zero UI labels, no neon cyberpunk clutter.
